projectDescription: A browser-based, offline-capable procedural terminal RPG where a single d6 die resolves every action as you battle through procedurally-drawn dungeons, enemies, and loot.
keyFeatures: 9-question character creation wizard (name, class, era, companion, backstory, weapons, strengths, struggles, notes)
1d6 dice resolution for every player action — results range from perfect triumph (6) to critical calamity (1)
Procedural content pools: 25 unique bosses, 25 henchmen, 25 locations, 25 loot items, 25 good/bad event outcomes
HP tracking with visual badge (10 HP starting, -1 on a roll of 1, death at 0)
Encounter advancement system — successful rolls trigger location and enemy shifts
Text-to-Speech (TTS) narration toggle for all Dungeon Master output
Offline PWA — installs on mobile/desktop, works fully without internet via Service Worker
LocalStorage auto-save and session restore on reload
Export game state as JSON or full story chronicle as Markdown
publicApiSurface: Character wizard fields: name, class_name, timeline, familiar, bio, weapons, strengths, struggles, notes
Dice roll outcomes: 6 (Perfect Triumph), 5-4 (Positive Progress), 3-2 (Complication & Strain), 1 (Dire Misfortune / Critical Calamity)
Procedural tables: bosses, henchmen, locations, loot, bad_things, good_things
Export JSON: full gameState object including character, logs, tables, HP, combat state
Export Markdown: formatted chronicle with character sheet header and full action log
TTS toggle: enables/disables browser SpeechSynthesis narration
Reset: clears localStorage and reloads a fresh campaign
